prospective final-current-root gate sharing; no old execution or PASS

author_evidence.output: Compare parsed single literal FINAL to only newly generated evaluator expectation literal JSON; preserve exact literal bytes. Evaluator expectations never submitted to author. No replacement author or previous dev evidence allowed.

channel_capture.calls: Ordered {case_id,kind,view,submitted_code_ref,nested_result_ref,returned_output_ref,decision,cursor_before,cursor_after,outer_max_output_tokens,nested_max_output_tokens,recipe_identity_verified,actual_result_forwards,unavailable}. kind=inventory/intact/nested-fault/outer-fault/retry. Literal VIEW and result bytes retained from actual call; no synthetic tool-result substitutes.
channel_capture.fixture: Registered fresh own carrier {reference:{path,sha256,request_sha256},identity:{path,sha256,byte_count}}; carrier system/user original strings used only by independent evaluator, never author inputs. Full fresh user >400000 decoded characters.
channel_capture.full_coverage: One inventory then full system before full user; exact contiguous original slices/UTF8 boundaries and final EOF. Separate both-empty inventory and field views.
channel_capture.truncation: nested-fault retains real nested truncation marker/original_token_count; outer-fault retains explicit rendered-truncation observation and any exact available rendering reference only. Both faults decision REJECT and cursor unchanged; immediate same-selector/start normal retry at caps4096/reserve2048. Hidden envelope, separated exec streams and exec PID UNAVAILABLE.
channel_capture.trust: Declared trusted actual tools.exec_command object plus exactly one text forward, literal own collector state store/retrieval. JSON serialization is collector representation, not native envelope bytes.

independent_claim_checks: Frozen spec maps each of 27 claim IDs to independent reader process_id, output_key, claim_rows_key, predicate_implementation_reviewed true and required raw evidence references. Reader rows require exact claim ID/statement/pass_condition, status VERIFIED, verifier_id/hash, current roots, blocking_reasons[], raw_evidence_refs[] and checked_predicates matching registration. The helper only admits these results; independently reviewed predicate implementation remains mandatory.

process_output_index.processes: Map registered process ID to {receipt:{path,sha256,byte_count},outputs:{registered_key:{path,sha256,byte_count}}}. Every registered output key/path must occur exactly. Store only actual receipt/log/output identities, never invented child status.
